title: TrafficSim
subtitle: Simulation core · Network model
description: Two crossing movements, seeded arrivals and fixed-time signals. Vehicles accelerate, queue and discharge along links and connectors.
scope: Delay includes source waiting and acceleration, for completed trips only. No lane changing, merge arbitration, crossing-conflict resolution or LOS evaluation.
invalidSeed: Enter an integer seed from 0 to 4294967295.
editorScope: Draw links, connect lanes and save your network. Running edited networks is not available yet. The simulation model is not yet validated.
editorNoSelection: Select a link or connector, or draw a new link.
editorHelp: Click to draw; Enter or double-click to finish; Esc cancels. Select and drag a point or link. Double-click a selected line to insert a point. Delete removes a selected point. Right/middle drag pans; wheel zooms. Splits include a 0.2 m continuity connector. The added pocket lane has no automatic demand or lane changing.
editorDeleteWarning: Delete this link and its attached connectors, signal heads, affected routes and their vehicle inputs? Undo restores them together.
editorError: The edit could not be completed:
EDIT_LANES: Use 1–12 lanes with positive widths. Enter one width for all lanes or one value per lane.
EDIT_REFERENCED_LANE: This lane is referenced by a connector, signal or route. Remove its references before reducing the lane count.
EDIT_SPLIT_RANGE: Choose a split more than 0.2 m from either end.
EDIT_SPLIT_SIGNAL: Splitting a link with signal heads is not available yet. The original document was kept.
EDIT_BACKGROUND_INVALID: Cannot use this image or transform. Use a valid image up to 32 megapixels and a positive scale.
EDIT_VERSION: This project version is not supported.
EDIT_FILE_READ: Cannot read the project file (limit: 48 MB).
EDIT_FILE_WRITE: Could not save. Your changes remain unsaved; the existing file was not replaced.
EDIT_ID_LIMIT: The project ID counter is invalid or exhausted.
EDIT_GAP: The carriageway gap must be zero or positive.
INVALID_GEOMETRY: Use at least two distinct points with a positive finite length.
editorDeleteConnectorWarning: Delete this connector, affected routes and their vehicle inputs? Undo restores them together.
editorPickSourceLane: Click an orange marker at the end of the source lane.
editorPickTargetLane: Click a teal marker at the start of the target lane. Esc cancels.
editorConnectorCanvasHint: Choose Connect lanes in the drawing tools to pick endpoints on the canvas.
editorConnectorHelp: Select from / to lanes and create, or pick lane endpoints on the canvas. In Select / move, drag white interior points; double-click to insert a point; Delete removes a point. Square endpoints stay attached to their lanes. Reset curve replaces the shape using the lane directions.
EDIT_CONNECTOR_LANES: Choose both the source and target lanes.
EDIT_CONNECTOR_ENDPOINTS: Connector endpoints stay attached to lanes. Use from / to to change the lane references.
EDIT_CONNECTOR_GAP: The lane endpoints coincide. Leave a gap between the links before creating a curve.
EDIT_REFERENCED_CONNECTOR: A route uses this connector. Its lane references cannot change until the route is removed or revised. You can still reshape the curve.
DUPLICATE_CONNECTION: These lanes already have a connector. Select the existing connector to edit it.
UNKNOWN_LANE: The selected lane does not exist. Choose a current lane.
